_note: SpeedKills' signature guns in the hands (src/game/viewmodel.ts, src/game/phase.ts). The owner (2026-09-27): tear through two guns, the USSO and BOOG, top tier animations, swapping, recoil, reloading, and have them phase in like Hyper Scape did; not realistic, futuristic. A gun listed here phases in and out of the hands instead of dropping out of the frame, kicks on its own spring, pulses its glow on a shot and phases its magazine out and a new one in on a reload. Ours, by eye against pictures and the game's own shot rates; every time is a share of the swap, the holster or the reload, every length metres in the gun's space, every turn radians.
_phase: The sweep (phase.ts): its colour; band, the lit edge's width, and jag, how far a cell may push the edge back, both shares of the gun's length; cell, the cell's size, a share of the length too, so the edge steps like pixels; lines, the scanlines along the gun, per length; ahead, how far ahead of the edge the scatter of flickering cells reaches, as a share of the length, and scatter, how thick it is at the edge.
_guns: Per gun. swap: the outgoing gun phases out over `out` of the swap and the incoming one in over `in` (the model changes at the swap's middle), and `move` is how much of the old drop out of the frame is kept (none would hide nothing from a player's eye; all of it would hide the phase); as it phases in it rises `rise` and unrolls `roll`. holster: the same over the holster's own fraction. kick: the recoil, a spring of its own (`spring` stiffness and `damp` damping, a shot adding `impulse` to its speed), moving the gun `back` and turning it `up`, `yaw` and `roll` a unit of it; buzz: a shake while firing, `amp` metres at `hz`. pulse: the glow jumps by `glow` times on a shot and falls back over `decay` s. charge (BOOG): over the rechamber the glow drains to `drained` and builds back, with a flash of `ready` as it is ready again. reload: the magazine drops `drop` (the plain reload's 0.32 took it out of the frame, and its phase with it) and phases out over `magOut`, the new one in over `magIn`, and it seats at `seat` with a snap of `snap` on the kick spring and a pulse.
